name.ja: Figure-rise Standard SEED ラクス・クライン

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム SEED』より「ラクス・クライン」をFigure-rise Standardで立体化！
description.en: "Lacus Clyne " from " Mobile Suit Gundam SEED" is three-dimensionalized with Figure-rise Standard!

description.ja: • 「通常顔」「笑顔」「困り顔」の３種類の表情パーツ付き。通常顔はタンポ印刷で表現。笑顔と困り顔は水転写式デカールを採用。
description.en: • Comes with 3 types of expression parts: "normal face ", " smiling face ", and " concerned face". The face is usually expressed by tampo printing. The smiling and troubled faces are water transfer decals.

description.ja: • プラモオリジナルのミニスカートバージョンも再現できる。
description.en: • You can also reproduce the miniskirt version of the plastic model original.

description.ja: • 各種ハンドパーツと、ラクスに「ピンクちゃん」と呼ばれていたハロが付属。
description.en: • Includes various hand parts and the halo that Lacus used to call "Pink-chan."

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ（タンポ印刷）×1種
accessories.en: Facial expression parts (tampo printing) x 1 type

accessories.ja: 手首パーツ　平手（左右）、祈り手（左右）、ハロ持ち手（左右）
accessories.en: Wrist parts Open hands (left and right), prayer hands (left and right), halo holding hands (left and right)

accessories.ja: ピンクハロ（耳開き、耳閉じ）×各1種
accessories.en: Pink halo (ears open, ears closed) x 1 type each
